headline: Germline-aware pangenome references reframe somatic variant discovery
label: Pangenome Somatic Variant Discovery
summary: Benchmarks and new long-read callers show graph and personalized pangenomes improving somatic variant detection relative to GRCh38.
synthesis: The dominant thread is somatic variant discovery anchored to germline-informed references rather than GRCh38. A published benchmark reports that graph and personalized pangenomes improve somatic variant calling accuracy relative to GRCh38. Two preprints extend this frame to structural variants from long reads. JANUS discovers somatic structural variants directly in tumor-normal pangenome graphs from HiFi reads without prior alignment, and VESPA-SS identifies tumor-specific strings against a draft composite germline reference. The new element is making the germline-aware reference or graph the primary frame for somatic analysis. Cycle-Extractor reconstructs ecDNA cycles from short- or long-read breakpoint graphs and addresses complex somatic events, but its summary does not describe a pangenome reference. GraffiTE, which genotypes structural variants and annotates transposable elements, is only loosely related.
